package.name: Control
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Use your phone as a touchpad and keyboard for a paired computer.

capabilities.control.use: Control a paired computer from this device, or let a paired device control this computer. Replaying input on this computer is a separate permission of the application.

exports.description: Carries pointer and keyboard input from a phone to a paired computer.

input.description: Sends what you do on the Remote page to the computer you chose.

view.description: Renders Control's own interface and interprets its raw UI events.

layout.description: Renders Control's desktop arrangement editor and handles its gestures.

receive.description: Replays on this computer what a paired device sends.

settings.label: Add layout to page
settings.help: Also show Layout as its own page; keep the original Layout in these settings.

settings.label: Independent pointer per device
settings.help: Each device that controls this computer gets a pointer of its own, apart from this computer's mouse. Needs a desktop that draws a pointer per tablet tool, such as GNOME; elsewhere the shared pointer moves.
